title: KCD: Knowledge Walks and Textual Cues Enhanced Political Perspective Detection in News Media

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying the political ideology or perspective (e.g., left, center, right) of news articles by constructing heterogeneous information networks (HIN) that integrate paragraph-level textual cues (topic, sentiment, tense, quotation, and entities) with multi-hop knowledge walks from an external political knowledge graph, and training relational graph neural networks to predict the stance.
